directivePlacement.text: The FLAG-14 directive may be specified only between clauses in divisions other than the procedure division and only between statements in the procedure division

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2023:7.3.15.2 general format: a list of syntax-option words with ON/OFF (§2023:7.3.15.3 GR4 names the options) — a structured operand, diagnosed by its own stage as COBOL1622.

description: The >>FLAG-14 { ALL | option... } { ON | OFF } migration-flagging directive (ISO §2023:7.3.15) — a COBOL-2023 addition: Annex E.2 item 5 lists FLAG-14 among the compiler-directive words new to 2023. It directs the implementor's warning mechanism to flag 2014-to-2023 incompatibilities (GR1). Recognized and collected by FlagDirectiveProcessor and folded per option per source line by FlagState (FlagConformancePass emits the per-option COBOL1621 warning); the introduction gate rejects the directive word below 2023.
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.15; Annex E.2 item 5 (compiler-directive words added in 2023)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FLG14.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
       >>FLAG-14 READ-PREVIOUS ON
           DISPLAY "Y".
           STOP RUN.
